newsitem.title: GERMANY: Court jails Germany's "fruit juice bombers".
newsitem.headline: Court jails Germany's "fruit juice bombers".

text.p: A court jailed two German brothers on Friday for attempting to extort three million marks ($2 million) from a supermarket chain by planting tiny bombs in cartons of fruit juice.

The court sentenced Christian and Rene Baisch to nine and four years respectively. The unemployed pair had confessed to planting the small explosives in juice cartons in several branches of the Aldi chain in April and May of last year.

The brothers, both in their 20s, were found drunk and asleep by police last May in a car investigators described as a "mobile blackmail office" containing drafts of ransom notes as well as equipment to make the small explosives.
Police had tracked them down through inquiries with electronics components mail order firms.
Three of the devices, which had the force of small fireworks, exploded on the supermarket shelves but caused no injuries.
